expectations.text: index.html honours prefers-reduced-motion by disabling or simplifying its motion (CSS media query or JS matchMedia check)
expectations.evidence: Reduced motion swaps to a static two-column layout with fades

expectations.text: index.html's main headline and body copy are visible with JavaScript disabled (nothing essential is left hidden by CSS waiting for a script)
expectations.evidence: With scripts removed a designed two-column hero with product, price and colours renders

expectations.text: index.html loads with no console errors
index.html animates only transform, opacity, clip-path or filter — no per-frame animation of top/left/width/height/margin
expectations.evidence: Static scan: no layout properties animated

expectations.text: index.html has no horizontal page scroll at a 390px-wide viewport
index.html varies entrance motion by element role (at least two distinct reveal treatments, e.g. line/mask reveal for headlines and scale/clip for media), rather than one identical fade-up everywhere
expectations.evidence: Case lid lift, bud rise, wave flatten, ring fill, dimension-line draw: distinct per feature

expectations.text: index.html uses no emoji and no default purple/indigo-to-blue/pink gradient
index.html reveals a code-built earbuds visual that transforms (scale, rotate, position or reveal) tied to scroll position
expectations.evidence: Case opens, buds rise and separate, tied to ScrollTrigger scrub

expectations.text: index.html has a pinned section (ScrollTrigger pin or position: sticky) in which features are explained one at a time as the user scrolls
expectations.evidence: One ScrollTrigger pin; Noise, Battery, Fit chapters shown one at a time

expectations.text: index.html shows the price $179, 40h battery, adaptive noise cancelling, and the three colours chalk, graphite and moss
expectations.evidence: $179, 40h, adaptive noise cancelling, chalk/graphite/moss all present

expectations.text: index.html simplifies or unpins the pinned sequence on phone widths so the content stays readable
expectations.evidence: On phones the pinned scene is reframed (product top, text below); no overflow
